t: This is the Maria Montessori Training Organisation in Camden, a building given over to the method of its namesake. Maria Montessori was an Italian physician and educator. She began medical school at the Sapienza University of Rome, one of the first women in Italy to do so, and graduated with honors in 1896. She is best known for her philosophy of education and her writing on scientific pedagogy, and her method is now used in public and private schools around the world.
